in_hebrew.name: Ginnifer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ginnifer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word γυνηφορός (gynēphorós), meaning ‘woman-bearer’ or ‘bringer of women’. The name Ginnifer may be a variant of Guinevere or Gwendolyn, both meaning ‘fair one’ or ‘white wave’.

in_greek.name: Ginnifer
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Fair, beautiful
in_greek.long_meaning: Ginnifer είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word γυνηφορός (gynēphorós), meaning ‘woman-bearer’ or ‘bringer of women’. The name Ginnifer may be a variant of Guinevere or Gwendolyn, both meaning ‘fair one’ or ‘white wave’.

in_latin.name: Ginnifer
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Fair, beautiful
in_latin.long_meaning: Ginnifer est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word γυνηφορός (gynēphorós), meaning ‘woman-bearer’ or ‘bringer of women’. The name Ginnifer may be a variant of Guinevere or Gwendolyn, both meaning ‘fair one’ or ‘white wave’.
